title.narrative: Supporting the emergency health response in Ukraine

description.narrative: Contributing to responding to the most urgent medical needs of the population in hard-to-reach areas of Ukraine
Improving access to life-saving health care and high-quality primary health care services for the most vulnerable people in hard-to-reach areas of Ukraine.

• Procure, store and distribute essential medicines, medical equipment and supplies • Supply and install modular prefabricated structures • Procure and distribute essential medical and diagnostic supplies to primary health care institutions • Procure and distribute rabies vaccine to address risks and reduce morbidity and mortality due to rabies • Support the prevention and management of waterborne diseases, including cholera • Ensure the provision of quality medical care services through telemedicine in remote and hard-to-reach areas
